evidenceNotes: Fresh successor independently verified main 8e5e892759ec2ddf033bb46f0c3d370c848615d5 and PR #92 merged state/head/merge boundary.
All 13 normal PR workflow families on exact PR #92 final head dc012a24e932c1e0dad500855a3220d02f3195e7 were independently rechecked green; submitted reviews and inline review threads were empty.
Open PR search found only superseded draft PRs #35 and #37. Historical branches remain numerous; Stage 2H work uses a fresh branch from verified live main.
Current Stage 2H source still authorizes only a non-provisioning Cloud Run/service-identity/IAM proof boundary and keeps Stage 3 blocked.

Current Google Cloud Firestore IAM documentation maps Stage 2G-style transaction begin/rollback to datastore.databases.get, document read to datastore.entities.get and create-only commit to datastore.entities.create; broader update/delete/list/index permissions are not required by that bounded operation.
Current Identity Platform IAM documentation maps GetAccountInfo to firebaseauth.users.get, relevant to Stage 2F revocation-aware verification's current-user lookup.

Current Cloud Run documentation recommends a dedicated user-managed service account with only required permissions; Firebase Admin documentation recommends Application Default Credentials on Google-managed runtimes such as Cloud Run.

Two recoverable routing limitations occurred during startup: generic branch-list fetch URL was unsupported by the connector, and direct public-site web open could not establish a safe route. Dedicated GitHub actions were used instead; neither is a repository defect.
